30.text: In a detailed description of a case of voluntary death, which I noted down

31.text: from the words of natives, it is said, “Since his father died this way, he

32.text: wanted to imitate him.” The father was stabbed with a knife; but, when

33.text: death did not come immediately, he requested that he be strangled with a

34.text: rope, which was done accordingly. The son also was stabbed, but the stroke

35.text: was not mortal. So he went still further in imitating his father, and also

36.text: requested that he might die by strangulation, which was immediately executed.
